meta.name: google-maps-scraper
meta.description: Find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details from Google Maps. Use for requests such as "find dentists in Berlin", "scrape Google Maps", "get local business leads", or "collect Google Maps reviews". Runs the open-source scraper locally with Docker and guides nontechnical users through setup, monitoring, and results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入城市和行业,批量收集本地商家的电话、邮箱与评价
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果靠本地商家名单做销售拓客,却不想手动一条条整理
copy.tagline_en: Collect local business phone numbers, emails, and reviews in bulk by city and industry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build local prospect lists for sales and dread compiling them by hand

howto.what: 它会把你说的需求写成 Google Maps 搜索词，在本机用 Docker 跑开源抓取器，后台跑完后给出商户（名称、评分、评论数、电话、网站等）预览表格，并可保存、筛选、分析或换格式导出。
howto.when: 当你想从 Google Maps 找商户、线索、评价或联系方式时触发，比如「查找柏林的牙医」这类请求。需要本机已安装并运行 Docker。

say.text: 帮我找柏林的牙医，先浅抓一遍看结果
say.note: 默认用 CSV、浅抓，约 20 条/查询，跑完给预览表

say.text: 把曼哈顿的咖啡店抓下来，并提取邮箱
say.note: 会开启邮箱提取，耗时更长

say.text: 用网格搜索把整个柏林的牙医尽量找全
say.note: 网格搜索更慢，可能超过 30 分钟

howto.what_en: It turns your request into Google Maps search queries, runs the open-source scraper locally with Docker, then shows a preview table of businesses (name, rating, reviews, phone, website) you can save, filter, analyze or export.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to find businesses, leads, reviews or contact details from Google Maps, e.g. "find dentists in Berlin". Requires Docker installed and running.

say_en.text: Find dentists in Berlin and do a shallow scrape first
say_en.note: Defaults to CSV, ~20 results per query
